privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Learn how EnCave collects, uses, and protects your personal data.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: EnCave SA ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:

items.personal: Personal information (name, email address, phone number)
items.usage: Usage data (how you interact with our platform)

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content: We use the information we collect to:

items.communication: Communicate with you about your experiences

dataSharing.title: Information Sharing
dataSharing.content: We share your information with wineries when you book an experience, and with service providers who assist us in operating our platform (such as Stripe for payments and Resend for emails). We do not sell your personal information.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. All payment data is processed through Stripe and is never stored on our servers.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: Under applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:

items.portability: Receive your data in a portable format

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Read the terms and conditions for using the EnCave platform.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using EnCave, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our platform.

services.title: Our Services
services.content: EnCave provides a platform connecting wine enthusiasts with wineries in Valais, Switzerland. We facilitate the booking of wine experiences but are not the provider of the experiences themselves.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: To use certain features of our platform, you may need to create an account. You are responsible for:

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.content: When you book an experience through EnCave, you enter into a direct agreement with the winery. EnCave acts as an intermediary to facilitate the booking process.

payments.title: Payments
payments.content: All payments are processed securely through Stripe. Prices are displayed in Swiss Francs (CHF). By making a booking, you authorize us to charge your payment method.

winemakers.title: Winemaker Obligations
winemakers.content: Winemakers using our platform agree to provide accurate information about their experiences, honor confirmed bookings, and maintain appropriate standards of service.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: All content on EnCave, including text, graphics, logos, and software, is the property of EnCave or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: EnCave is not liable for the quality, safety, or legality of experiences offered by wineries. We do not guarantee the accuracy of information provided by wineries.

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

governing.title: Governing Law
governing.content: These terms are governed by Swiss law. Any disputes will be resolved in the courts of Valais, Switzerland.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at:

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.description: Understand our cancellation and refund policies for wine experience bookings.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: We understand that plans can change. This policy outlines our cancellation and refund procedures for bookings made through EnCave.

clientPolicy.title: Client Cancellation Policy
clientPolicy.content: As a client, you may cancel your booking subject to the following conditions:

over24h.time: More than 24 hours before the experience

wineryPolicy.title: Winery Cancellation
wineryPolicy.content: If a winery cancels your booking, you will receive a full refund regardless of the timing. We will also assist you in finding an alternative experience if desired.

noShow.title: No-Show Policy
noShow.content: If you do not arrive for your booked experience without prior cancellation, no refund will be provided.

modifications.title: Booking Modifications
modifications.content: To modify your booking (date, time, or number of guests), please contact the winery directly or through our platform at least 24 hours before your scheduled experience.

refunds.title: Refund Processing
refunds.content: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days and will be returned to your original payment method.

exceptional.title: Exceptional Circumstances
exceptional.content: In cases of force majeure (natural disasters, severe weather, etc.), we will work with both parties to find a suitable solution, which may include rescheduling or full refund.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For cancellation requests or questions about this policy, please contact us at:
